topic: Gorilla versus one hundred bodybuilders debate
question: Who wins in a bare-arena fight: one adult male silverback gorilla or one hundred coordinated bodybuilders?
display_question: 빈 경기장에서 성체 수컷 실버백 고릴라 1마리와 헬창 100명이 붙으면 누가 이길까?

rounds.title: Round 1
rounds.instruction: Present your opening position from your private research. Do not dump research notes. State the side you defend, the strongest reason, and one uncertainty.

rounds.title: Round 2
rounds.instruction: Respond to at least one previous speaker by name. Attack weak assumptions, missing constraints, and unrealistic tactics. Hold your position unless public evidence changes it.

rounds.title: Round 3
rounds.instruction: Give a concise final stance after hearing the room. Say what you still reject, what you partially accept, and what the moderator must not overclaim.

roles.research_focus: gorilla size, strength, bite force, injury risk, animal behavior, panic response, and fatigue

personality.tone: pedantic Korean biology nerd, stubborn about real animal constraints and evidence quality

personality.tone: confident Korean gym-bro tactician, practical, competitive, slightly cocky but evidence-aware
